title: A Codex worker delegation on Windows cannot start any terminal process (CreateProcessAsUserW error 5)
outcome: A Codex worker delegation on Windows cannot start any terminal process (CreateProcessAsUserW error 5)
acceptance: The cause is identified with source and runtime evidence: which sandbox or token setting makes CreateProcessAsUserW return error 5 for a Codex worker child in an isolated worktree on Windows
A Codex worker delegation in an isolated worktree on Windows can run an ordinary read command and a focused test, proven by a host-recorded run
If the restriction is intended, the spawn tool refuses or warns before it starts such a worker, instead of letting the worker fail after its first turn
